first_verified_proof_boundary: both arms invoke prover without internal native verification, then a fresh source-embedded native verifier process on the same canonical typed public statement; include both wall times and process startups
phase_integrity_gate: append and fsync canonical raw per-arm process evidence in a SHA256 hash-chain ledger; externally timestamp the full phase-root digest before audit or summary; replay all reported metrics and identities from the anchored raw ledger
build_integrity_gate: append and fsync canonical monotonic per-build events in a separate SHA256 hash-chain ledger; bind its root, exact build-times bytes, and independently regenerated package identities into the externally anchored proof phase root; audit rederives every reported build duration
live_security_config_gate: record each arm's live PCS from source-embedded inspector; require identical complete FriConfigV2 and interaction PoW bits, report geometry-dependent lifting sizes separately; security equivalence remains unproven
